questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why does hiding Fact-table foreign key IDs (e.g., `FactSales[CustomerID]`) improve report usability and accuracy?

options.text: Prevents accidental slicing by incomplete transaction keys instead of clean complete attributes inside `DimCustomer`
Deletes foreign key data from disk freeing 50% RAM
Forces DirectQuery conversion
Removes duplicate sums automatically

questions.explanation: Users should slice strictly by Dimension attributes while aggregating Fact measures.

questions.prompt: Why should indiscriminate bi-directional (`Both`) relationship filtering across multiple Fact tables be avoided?

options.text: Creates ambiguous circular filter paths that fail deployment and slow VertiPaq queries down significantly
Bi-directional filters block dark-mode styling
Removes numeric decimals from currency measures
Prevents exporting PBIX files to PDF

questions.explanation: Single-directional Star filters keep semantic behavior crisp and unambiguous.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint
questions.prompt: In a well-tuned Star Schema comparing Sales against Budgets, how are `FactSales` and `FactBudgets` connected?

options.text: Both are filtered cleanly downwards (`1 -> *`) by shared conformed Dimensions like `DimDate` and `DimStore` without directly joining Fact-to-Fact
Linked directly via a Many-to-Many bridge without Dimensions
Merged sideways into a single duplicated row table
Left disconnected and unified using visual text overlays

questions.explanation: Conformed Dimensions synchronize filtering across disparate granularities safely.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why do bar charts plot `'April, August, December'` before `'January'` until fixed?

options.text: Month names are text strings sorted alphabetically unless 'Sort by Column' maps them to numeric `MonthNumber` (1–12)
Power BI defaults to fiscal Australian quarters
Slicers reverse text arrays automatically
Dates lack VertiPaq dictionaries

questions.explanation: Mapping text month/weekday labels to numeric sort columns fixes chronological axis display cleanly.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint
questions.prompt: How do you activate an inactive dashed relationship between `DimDate[Date]` and `FactSales[ShipDate]` inside one specific metric?

options.text: Wrap the metric inside `CALCULATE(..., USERELATIONSHIP(FactSales[ShipDate], DimDate[Date]))`
Delete the active `OrderDate` relationship dynamically
Turn on bi-directional filters across all dimensions
Multiply values by `RELATED(DimDate[Date])`

questions.explanation: `USERELATIONSHIP()` activates dormant links deterministically during that measure's calculation.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint
questions.prompt: What breaks when a Date table contains ONLY dates that actually had sales transactions (skipping weekends/holidays)?

options.text: Time Intelligence functions (`SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR`, `TOTALYTD`) misalign or output blanks because they assume contiguous daily calendar spans
Tables refuse to save as UTF-8
SUM metrics turn negative on Mondays
Tooltips disable automatically

questions.explanation: Always span full Jan 1–Dec 31 calendar ranges cleanly via `CALENDAR()`.
